script: { d=$(mktemp -d); cd "$d"; st(){ s=dead; if [ -r "/proc/$1/stat" ]; then read -r _ _ s _ <"/proc/$1/stat"; [ "$s" = Z ] && s=dead; fi; echo "$s"; }; set +m; /bin/sh -c 'echo $$ >p1; kill -STOP $$; echo ran >ran' & p=$!; until [ -s p1 ]; do /bin/sleep .01; done; read a <p1; until [ "$(st $a)" = T ]; do /bin/sleep .01; done; set -m; kill -TERM $a 2>/dev/null; echo "kill=$?"; /bin/sleep .3; i=0; while [ $i -lt 300 ]; do sa=$(st $a); case "$sa" in dead|T) break;; esac; /bin/sleep .01; i=$((i+1)); done; echo "a=$(st $a)"; ran=no; [ -s ran ] && ran=yes; echo "ran=$ran"; /bin/kill -KILL "$a" 2>/dev/null; wait 2>/dev/null; cd /; rm -rf "$d"; } 2>/dev/null
